$comment: Advisories CI accepts in runtime dependencies, each approved by the product owner. scripts/audit.mjs fails on any other high or critical advisory, on an exception past its reviewBy date, and on an exception that no longer matches anything (remove it).

exceptions.reason: ReDoS through attacker-supplied extglob patterns. No fixed picomatch version exists (all versions affected). It is only reached through next-intl's message-extraction file watcher, which Zelvo does not use; @parcel/watcher is not in the built web image, and glob patterns are never taken from users.
